MAGNOVITE 2026

The 16th Edition • CHRIST University Kengeri Campus

WELCOME TO MAGNOVITE '26

MAGNOVITE is the annual flagship fest organised by CHRIST (Deemed To be University), Kengeri Campus. It is an enigmatic nexus of creativity and collaboration, bringing healthy competition and positive connections between participants. It returns this year with its 16th edition, bringing back its unfading charm.

ENGINEERING & INNOVATION

34+ NATIONAL COMPETITIONS

From high-stakes Robo Soccer, 24-hr Hackathons, to deep cybersecurity CTFs, AI modeling challenges, and CAD structural design sprints.

CULTURE & RHYTHM

ELECTRIFYING STAGE SHOWDOWNS

Battle of the Bands, Street Dance ciphers, Acapella vocal harmonies, short film screenings, and open-air dramatic street theater.
